This indicates a highly active, well-maintained package ecosystem. metric.package_ecosystem_activity_mainte.limitations: Raw popularity indicators (GitHub stars, download counts) were recorded only as secondary, declared evidence alongside release-cadence and maintenance-policy evidence, consistent with the requirement that such raw counts not be used as a standalone proxy for the whole evaluation.
metric.package_ecosystem_activity_mainte.selection_rule: Use the primary package registry/ecosystem for the language when one exists and evaluate current observable maintenance within the fixed activity window; package count alone is never sufficient.

component_findings.application_testing: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-external--part-1--java): Predeclared domain/library sampling per Section 'Predeclared sampling'. Selection rule frozen before collection: for each application domain, the target library is (a) the artifact recommended/defaulted by the language's official or de-facto standard tooling (Spring Initializr defaults, JCP/JPA standardization), OR (b) the top-ranked artifact in that domain's category on mvnrepository.com/Maven Central popularity rankings. Candidate universe = mvnrepository.com category listings (Testing, Logging Frameworks, JSON Libraries, etc.) plus Maven Central search. Retrieval route = web search snapshot on 2026-09-22 against project GitHub release pages, official project sites, and Wikipedia infoboxes
